It was sent to my son's address in Washington DC, but I'd like to change it to my default address instead. Also, I want to make a couple of adjustments to the items in the order. Could you help me with that?
Sure! My name is Ivan Khan, and my zip code is 28243. Unfortunately, I don't remember the email address I used for the order.

Yes, please go ahead and change the shipping address to my default address.

For the items, I'd like to change the desk lamp to the black color instead of silver. Also, for the backpack, I want it to be medium size and made of polyester material. If there are multiple colors available for the backpack, I prefer grey.

Please let me know if you need any more details before proceeding.

Thank you for the details. Actually, I've reconsidered, and I'd prefer to only modify the backpack for now. Please keep the desk lamp as it is.

For the payment method, let's use PayPal to cover the price difference for the backpack.

Please proceed with updating the backpack to the grey, medium, polyester option and charge the difference to PayPal.
Yes, I confirm that changing only the backpack is the only modification I want to make to the order. Please go ahead with the update. Thank you!

No, that's all for now. Thank you very much for your help and patience! Have a great day!
